basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old railway enthusiast hailing from Manchester, UK. I work as a civil engineer specializing in railway infrastructure, and when I'm not at work, I'm either playing train simulation games or collecting sportscards. I appreciate the blend of history, technology, and logistics in railway systems. My dislikes include cluttered interfaces and overly aggressive marketing. I'm typically online during evenings and weekends. Divorced, with a couple of cats who enjoy keeping me company during my late-night gaming sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in railways stems from both my professional background as a civil engineer and a lifelong passion for trains. I have a degree in civil engineering and have worked on several railway projects across the UK. Additionally, I have self-taught extensive historical knowledge of railways through books and documentaries.
